verdict.rationale: Base44 is itself an AI app builder whose core interaction model is delegating tasks to its built-in AI (describe idea, send instructions to AI, ask for design options, generate videos, build via chat) as shown in docs-12/14/21 and llms.txt, and community reports confirm this works hands-on (comm-1, comm-2, comm-3). missing for 10: no detailed documentation of assistant scope/limits, no independent benchmark of task delegation reliability beyond anecdotal HN comments, and some community skepticism about token costs when delegating complex tasks (comm-6).
